Summary: Because of persistent idolatry, Israel and Judah were carried into exile, losing land, temple, and king, yet God did not abandon them there. Prophets like Jeremiah and Ezekiel spoke hope in exile, and under Cyrus God brought His people home to rebuild. The return was real but incomplete, pointing forward to the greater restoration Jesus brings.
